windows.promotionTiming: MLB debuts 2022-present (current rookie rule); age for level 2023-present
windows.approach: current active hitters (zone metrics; no history)

rule.text: Rookie status ends past 130 AB, 50 IP or 45 active-roster days (IL excluded). Since 2020 September counts, so a first call-up on or after the cutoff keeps rookie status for next season. The cutoff is 45 days before the final scheduled game (July 18 before 2020). One service year is 172 days, so a call-up more than 15 days after Opening Day cannot bank a full year that season.

trades.note: prospect-capital lens: 'in'/'out' count distinct tracked-prospect moves between two of the 30 clubs, from the MLB transaction feed plus org changes seen on board snapshots; a move reversed for the same player within 90 days (A to B to A) is read as two sources disagreeing and drops, except that two feed moves both count and a feed move outranks a snapshot-inferred one; FV graded from board snapshots within ±120d of the trade, ungraded moves are counted, never guessed

graduation.note: draft hit rate = signed picks 2021+ reaching MLB / signed picks 2021+ — recent classes have little runway, so the z (relative) is the read

hitterApproach.note: current approach lean vs league (level-adjusted); zone-metric history isn't archived yet, so no development drift

notes: every value is league-relative: z = (org minus league mean) / league sd across the 30 orgs; labels fire at |z| >= 0.5, except the promotion badge, which needs a tested difference (BH q < 0.10, CI95 clear of the league)

arsenal BLENDS the MLB arsenals of an org's graduates with the Savant-minors arsenals of its current AAA arms (each arm counted once); the table is the average arm's pitch mix vs league. about half of AAA arms can't be org-attributed, so the AAA arm count is partial, disclosed per org
pitchStuff: per-pitch velo + arm-side movement (AAA Gameday pfx) vs league; velo blends AAA + MLB

toolDev measures grade drift per prospect-year inside the org from SAME-SOURCE snapshot pairs (>=60d apart); cross-source noise never counts as development; the club on each date comes from the player's org tenures (dated transactions), and a pair that spans a club change is split by days between the clubs
graduation counts each graduate at the clubs that developed him, by development share (graduate-equivalents), not at the club he plays for now
SC+ drift covers the platform's metric-snapshot window only (2026-05 onward), an early read, labeled as such
trade quality/depth grades acquired prospects from board snapshots within 120 days of the trade; ungraded moves count toward volume only
graduation draft-hit-rate denominator is signed picks 2021+ (little MLB runway for recent classes; read the z, not the absolute)
hitterApproach is a current level-adjusted LEAN vs league, not a development drift (zone-metric history isn't archived)
